frozen_params.fit: single-parameter Plummer fit: band fraction = m(r2/a)-m(r1/a), m(x)=x^3/(1+x^2)^{3/2}, equal relative weights over the three detection bands
frozen_params.tolerance: |rel resid| <= 0.25 per detection band (analytic); regenerated histograms must verify within tolerance after binomial noise and sampler discretization

density_matching.inner_region_note: at a=6.8 the same Plummer mismatches inner bands badly (1-2 kpc -86%, 10-20 kpc +43%, 20-30 kpc +70%): the mock is an analog of the DETECTION REGION ONLY, never a global Auriga profile; all transferability claims are region-limited
density_matching.support_note: mock mass beyond q=7 (70 kpc) is about 1.4%; the T4 constraints pool mirrors the S1 edges [0.1,7] and out-of-pool handling follows the selection rule with score corrected as s_sel = s + grad log S (plan A2)

mock_design.rcut_caveat: if an r-cut/selection variant is reused (legacy rcut1.0 configs), the oracle score must be the SELECTED DF's score, never the uncut Plummer score
mock_design.self_consistency_caveat: the mock is a self-consistent Plummer (Phi from its own mass); Auriga's potential is total-matter dominated (M_total/M_star ~ 8.7), so velocity scales at fixed r differ - documented limitation; never transfer absolute error bounds from Plummer to Auriga

Auriga Stein tests are exploratory-grade in round 1.
conclusions.true_potential_and_acceleration: POINT-SAMPLE TRUE POTENTIAL EXISTS; NO PER-PARTICLE ACCELERATION; NO 3D FIELD PRODUCT. (1) clean-smooth source halo12_all_mass_clean_outer_clump_smooth.h5 carries per-particle potential (n=1619615, join by particle_id); raw snapshot snapdir_127 has Potential blocks for PartType0/1/4 and NO Acceleration block. (2) The 96^3 truth product (sha256 e02379fa96a5c0fd621e4327cdd661c703ca82d183a6ddd4c099e7f4c8cb407a, copies in run snapshots 313e0cc7/e66ac2dd) was built from positions+masses only: density grids + spherical monopole phi_sphere_mean(24) + phi_dirs(24,2048) + phi_slice(240x240). (3) Non-spherical true-potential information is therefore available AT PARTICLE POSITIONS, but reading alpha*(q) needs local gradient estimation with error propagation (outer sparse region = hardest case), and units are unverified (adapter says acceleration_unit=unknown). Appendix A5 conditionally feasible; Auriga force-side primary conclusions remain identifiability/sensitivity/Phi-consistency; grid-truth resolution policy >= 10 kpc quantitative / < 5 kpc diagnostic unchanged.
conclusions.compatible_mock_nf: NO USABLE TRAINED MOCK NF. Legacy server files plummer_n*.h5 are eta-only without lineage (see mock_design.legacy_data_disqualified) and no mock checkpoints are pinned anywhere; mock_dust.py is an unrelated HEALPix dust mock. T4 still requires a NEW mock DF training node with explicit budget.
